**Los Angeles Clippers – Notable Players (NBA)**  

| Era | Notable Players | Notes |
|-----|-----------------|-------|
| **Early years (1970s‑1980s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short stint) | The Clippers were originally the Buffalo Braves, then the San Diego Clippers before moving to LA. |
| **1990s** | *Chris Kaman*, *Julius Randle* (early career), *Derrick Coleman* | The team struggled but had solid role players. |
| **2000s** | *Blake Griffin* (2009‑2015), *DeAndre Jordan* (2008‑2017), *Chris Paul* (2007‑2010), *Julius Randle* (2010‑2013), *J.J. Redick* (2011‑2013) | The “Lob City” era began with Griffin, Jordan, and Paul. |
| **2010s** | *Paul George* (2013‑2019), *Julius Randle* (2013‑2019), *Kawhi Leonard* (2019‑2020), *Kyrie Irving* (2020‑2021), *Paul George* (2021‑2022), *Kawhi Leonard* (2022‑present) | The Clippers became a perennial playoff contender. |
| **2020s (current roster)** | *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Julius Randle*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Jalen Green*, *Jabari Smith Jr.*, *Bam Adebayo* (trade), *Julius Randle* (return), *Jalen Green* (draft), *Jabari Smith Jr.* (draft) | The team is built around the “Big Three” of George, Leonard, and Randle, with a mix of young talent and veterans. |
